title: One run, one plugin
description: S3LightFixes reads the lights and interior cells of every plugin in your load order and writes the fixed versions into one plugin that loads after them.

nodes.title: openmw.cfg
nodes.detail: Your load order: every content= file, found through the data= directories.

nodes.title: s3lightfixes
nodes.detail: Takes the last version of each light record, recolors it, resizes its radius, stretches its duration and strips its flicker.

nodes.title: S3LightFixes.omwaddon
nodes.detail: Every light, fixed, plus the interior cells you asked to relight. Enable it last.

nodes.title: lightconfig.toml
nodes.detail: Multipliers, exclusions and per-light overrides. Written on the first run; command-line options override it.

nodes.title: lightconfig.log
nodes.detail: One line per record changed, old value and new, beside lightconfig.toml.
